messages:
deploy-bot: Starting patch rollout rdx-1.2.4-patch -> prod-us-east-1 (tag: rdx-1.2.4
commit: ab12c3d). Owner: @alice. Targets: 3 nodes in pool-prod-7. Strategy: rolling, 1 node at a time. ETA ~6m. Please ack.

alice: Acked. I'll run smoke tests as each instance finishes.

ben: I'll keep an eye on the ingress dashboards and error rates. :eyes: Dashboards: https://dash.company/redwood/prod-ingress

carla: If p50 latency >200ms or 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 2m, we auto-fail and rollback. Escalate if you see anything else.

deploy-bot: node-1 updated (node id n-13). smoke-tests: passed.

deploy-bot: node-2 updated (n-14). smoke-tests: passed.

alice: Applying last node now. Running post-deploy health check.

deploy-bot: node-3 updated (n-15). smoke-tests: failed — 502 from model-proxy on 2/6 requests.

ben: seeing a small 5xx spike concentrated on worker pool 7 (pods: rdx-model-7-*). Ramp to 1.1% for ~90s.

carla: that crosses our threshold. Recommend rollback to rdx-1.2.3. Any objections?

drew-oncall: Confirmed errors correlated with recent rollout windows in Sentry (issue: S-442). Root causes need investigation. No objections to rollback.

alice: Initiating rollback and pinning traffic back to rdx-1.2.3. Command: `/deploy rollback rdx-1.2.4-patch --to rdx-1.2.3 --env prod-us-east-1`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for rdx-1.2.4-patch -> rdx-1.2.3. Rolling back 3 nodes, parallel=1.

deploy-bot: node-3 rolled back (n-15) — smoke-tests passed.

deploy-bot: node-2 rolled back (n-14) — smoke-tests passed.

deploy-bot: node-1 rolled back (n-13) — smoke-tests passed.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Production steady on rdx-1.2.3. Summary: rollback due to 5xx spike in model-proxy; Sentry S-442 attached. No data exposure.

carla: Please open a postmortem and include reproduction steps and the failing request traces. Assign to the ML infra team and @alice.

alice: Will create the postmortem and a follow-up patch. Tentative next tag: rdx-1.2.5 with additional proxy retry logic.

drew-oncall: Thanks everyone. I'll extend monitoring alert retention and add a temporary canary for model-proxy.

ben: thx. marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
